patterns.name: ioctl_surface
patterns.rationale: filesystem ioctls are dense with attacker-controlled structures.

patterns.name: procfs_surface
patterns.rationale: procfs and debugfs often expose low-friction user entrypoints.

patterns.name: user_pointer
patterns.rationale: explicit userspace pointers highlight trust boundaries.

patterns.name: copy_from_user
patterns.rationale: usercopy in FS handlers often precedes bounds mistakes.

patterns.name: copy_to_user
patterns.rationale: filesystem read paths can leak stale kernel data.

patterns.name: size_math
patterns.rationale: size calculations around file operations are overflow-prone.

patterns.name: allocator
patterns.rationale: allocation under user-controlled lengths increases exploitability.

patterns.name: free_path
patterns.rationale: error unwind and teardown sites are good UAF candidates.
